label: Python e2e tests (pytest-playwright)
description: End-to-end tests of Python components with the project's pytest-playwright against its compose services (jgates.yml services:), Chromium from the toolchain volume. Comes in by evidence: pytest-playwright in requirements*.txt or pyproject.toml; runs only where e2e is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Without a services section it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
